scope: Explicit manual definition-bound behavior execution; no world operations, automatic triggers, previews or privileged grants

gates.requiredObservation: First managed startup has no fixture modules, behavior sources or pre-disable commands; official plugin disable returns promptly, existing coordinator if any and startup catalog/module/file work reach actual quiescence with no behavior threads. Normal scheduler race is recorded; deterministic close-before-owner-start coverage remains separate.
Three fixture modules active, bad schema module failed; eight capabilities; no partial bad-schema capabilities.
`behaviors validate/list/status` preserve exact bytes, report accepted revision/hash, and identify four intentional compiler failures.
Explicit run on an existing dormant synthetic definition returns execution UUID and captures its stable identity/revision. Physical NPC services stay disabled.
A second run on the same NPC is BUSY without replacing its first execution.
Long/integer, decimal, boolean and Unicode values reach the handler exactly; false selects else and never enters the failing branch.
Exactly ten record entries/two conditions, three loop records; branch-local ordering and final join respected without imposing cross-branch order.
Root/final wait remains running until the reported due logical tick and then completes.
Literal wrong type and typed binding to wrong property type fail before record handler entry; exact field diagnostics remain visible.
Missing capability remains preserved/visible and unavailable; no handler or privileged operation occurs.
Recursive routine and bounded nested repetition reach explicit depth/step budgets; no leaked fibers/calls.
Two branches writing one variable fail explicitly instead of choosing a winner.
Cancel returns terminal cancellation, captured token becomes true, raw future remains unfinished and engine retired-call/host capacity remains counted.
Independent controller release settles the actual raw future; engine and host counters drain to zero; cancelled execution never runs its following action.
Exact unchanged accepted behavior reload preserves running execution ID, source/revision and wait progress.
Malformed edit keeps last accepted program/source authority; bytes stay invalid and diagnostics identify the field. It does not invent durable restart recovery.
Changed bytes at unchanged revision reject while retaining the accepted program and active execution.
Higher accepted behavior revision cancels the prior execution and token; late completion cannot continue the old program; a new explicit run uses new source.
Missing source revokes authority and cancels; restoration of exact accepted bytes restores lookup, without auto-resuming execution.
Administrator edit publishes a new definition revision/source; old execution cancels and old raw handler stays counted until release.

Seed an owned definition `spawned=true` through file/reload while physical NPC service is disabled; real `despawn` publishes false/new revision and cancels execution. This is definition intent, not physical Folia despawn.
Delete owned source/checkpoint; execution cancels; separate surviving control definition releases its raw future.
Recorded engine limits bound outstanding and retired calls; cancellation does not free capacity prematurely. Poll exact counts and release explicitly; no assumed timing SLA.

Capture only pure diagnostic access before official disable; admission revokes immediately, executions cancel, trusted module hooks finish raw work, and actual host/engine quiescence is observed. No classloader-scan or background warmup stands in for cleanup.
Real stop/restart retains valid source/definition files but does not resume an interrupted transient execution stack. Explicit manual run is required.
Latest reports bind exact platform/version/artifact and all source/fixture hashes; owned synthetic files/pointers removed, all servers stopped, ports closed, no unexplained log failures.

requires: New reviewed runtime11 artifact; all checks remain unverified until managed reports pass
